diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the check C6 passed despite the lone decision-maker never having access to PF1. This suggests that the model is defaulting to adding monitoring for the image-processing queue (PF1) as a standard response, even when that information is not available. This default behavior allows the model to satisfy C6 without needing the hidden information.
